title: Zoology : Blood Circulation Flashcards
description: Key facts from TNPSC Group II Zoology Blood Circulation Chapter

cards.q: Who discovered that the heart acts as a pump?
Who first reported the presence of valves in veins?
What are the three layers of the heart wall from outer to inner?
What is the normal weight and length of the human heart?
Which blood vessels supply blood to the walls of the blood vessels themselves?
Which is the only artery in the body that carries deoxygenated (impure) blood?
Which valve is located at the left auriculo-ventricular opening?
What is the SA Node also known as?
What is the normal heart beat rate for an adult man?
What is the total duration of a single cardiac cycle?
cards.a: 0.8 seconds (or minutes as written in source text).

cards.q: What term is used for a heart beat rate that is lower than normal?
Who invented the stethoscope used to hear heart sounds?
What heart sound is produced by the closure of semilunar valves?
Who invented the Sphygmomanometer to measure blood pressure and in what year?
What is the normal blood pressure of a human?
Who invented the ECG and who first recorded it?
cards.a: Invented by Einthoven (1906); First recorded by Waller (1907).

cards.q: In an ECG, what does the P wave represent?
Who performed the first heart transplant operation?
Who performed the first artificial heart operation?
